name: Shrubify
subtitle: Made by shrubbery & the ShrubHub team
description: A community fork of EeveeSpotify Reincarnated. Liquid Glass settings on iOS 26, with Spotify’s original colors preserved. Unofficial, not affiliated with Spotify.

apps.name: Shrubify
apps.subtitle: Clean Spotify customization
apps.localizedDescription: Shrubify provides its own clean settings, app icon, developers page and stability diagnostics. Open-source upstream contributions are credited in the source repository.

versions.localizedDescription: Shrubify v2.0.0 for Spotify 9.1.94. iOS 26 Liquid Glass settings; compatibility depends on Spotify version.
